CSV Format

Your CSV should include these columns:

Item Name (required) - Product title
Price (required) - Price in dollars (e.g., 9.99)
Group - Group ID to link variants together
Variant / Sub Variant - Variant options (e.g., Color, Size)
Quantity - Stock count or formula (e.g., "(SKU-NAME)*5")
SKU, Category, Tags, Images - Optional fields
